title: Monthly Security Report - PKF Africa

ragStatus.detail: Many blocked USB events; one open incident.
No vulnerability events; scanning gaps likely.
Access controls untested against recent events.
Removable-media controls active but not enforced.
No cloud incidents recorded this period.

criticalActions: Enforce USB-block policy and remove admin override where unnecessary.
Harden EDR agent tamper protections and validate agent integrity.
Implement baseline vulnerability scanning and automated ticketing.

executiveSummary: Period overview: 30-day window recorded 3,685 security events? (data sources total 4,685 events), 348 incidents (Endpoint-focused), 347 endpoint events, 2 high-severity incidents, 346 medium, 1 open incident, 0 tickets open. Operations: high detection coverage; gaps in vulnerability scanning and ticketing. Top risks: removable-media data exfil via USB (majority of incidents), EDR tampering attempts (1 high-severity), absence of vulnerability telemetry. Recommended actions: enforce USB controls, harden EDR, deploy vulnerability scanning and automated incident ticketing. Immediate focus: close open USB incident and validate EDR integrity.

keyHighlights.label: High-Severity Incidents
keyHighlights.context: Resolved: EDR tamper and file op

domains.detail: Protective controls in place; enforcement inconsistent.

findings.title: Removable-media detections concentration
findings.description: Approximately 340+ 'Insertion of Storage Device Detected' incidents; majority blocked; one remains open.
findings.mitreTechnique: T1036 - Modify system image / T1056 - Input Capture (removable media)

findings.title: EDR tamper attempt
findings.description: Attempt To Terminate Cynet Process recorded and resolved; indicates targeted EDR interference.

findings.title: Unauthorized file operation detected
findings.description: Unauthorized File Operation Attempt detected and resolved; potential lateral or privilege misuse indicator.

findings.title: No vulnerability events recorded
findings.description: Vulnerability event count is zero; suggests scanning/configuration gap rather than no findings.

recommendations.title: Enforce removable-media policy
recommendations.description: Block USB usage by default; allow exceptions via documented approval workflow; close open USB incident immediately.

recommendations.title: Harden EDR and validate agents
recommendations.description: Enable tamper-protection, verify agent integrity across endpoints, and escalate anomalies to SOC.

recommendations.title: Deploy vulnerability scanning
recommendations.description: Implement authenticated scanning and ingest results into ticketing for prioritized remediation.

recommendations.title: User awareness on removable media
recommendations.description: Targeted communications and quick micro-training on USB risks for high-use groups.

recommendations.title: Automate incident ticketing
recommendations.description: Integrate EDR alerts to ticketing to ensure traceable remediation and metrics.

riskMatrix.treatmentPlan: Enable tamper protection and integrity checks.
Deploy authenticated scanning and remediation pipeline.
Automate alerts into ticketing and SLAs.

sections.title: Incident Status Summary
sections.content: 348 incidents: 347 resolved, 1 open. Majority are endpoint removable-media detections. No tickets logged.
sections.keyInsight: High resolution rate; one outstanding USB incident.

sections.title: Severity Breakdown
sections.content: Severity distribution: High = 2, Medium = 346. High incidents resolved; medium incidents dominated by USB blocks.

sections.title: Event Source Distribution
sections.content: Endpoint events = 347 of 4,685 total events; email and vulnerability sources show zero events this period.
sections.keyInsight: Endpoint is primary telemetry source; other sources require validation.

complianceMapping.gap: Physical/removable media controls require proof of enforcement

conclusion: Posture: detection strong at endpoint level; operational gaps remain in vulnerability management, ticketing, and removable-media enforcement. Priorities next period: enforce USB policy, harden EDR agents, deploy vulnerability scanning and automated ticketing to reduce residual risk.
